research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Ridecell is researching systems for autonomous vehicle fleets. Systematic Approach Towards System Identification Based Yaw Rate Estimation addresses estimating dynamic yaw attributes using inertial measurement data. System And Method For Adjusting Vehicle Location covers repositioning autonomous vehicles in a fleet to more accessible or advantageous locations. Dynamic Multi-Modal Mobility Service Platform focuses on generating routes from multiple mobility sources. Together these works target vehicle dynamics, fleet positioning, and route optimization.

overview_description.description:
Ridecell Inc. is the way in the digital transformation of fleet businesses and operations. Our Fleet IoT (Internet of Things) Automation solutions modernize and monetize fleets by combining data insights with digital vehicle control to turn today’s manual processes into automated workflows. The result is unmatched levels of efficiency and control for shared services, motorpools, rental, and logistic fleets.

Today Ridecell powers some of the most successful fleet businesses in cities across Europe and North America, including Ferrovial, Groupe Renault, Gig Car Share from AAA, and Toyota Sweden. Ridecell is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Madrid, Paris, Berlin, and Pune India.

product.name: Ridecell 360
product.description: A cloud-based AI platform that integrates data from multiple systems to provide real-time insights and automate workflows across the vehicle lifecycle for fleet leasing and management.

product.name: Supplier Intelligence
product.description: An AI-powered solution for managing and evaluating supplier performance within fleet management companies.

product.name: Order to Delivery Management
product.description: A solution that increases visibility and removes bottlenecks in the vehicle order to delivery process for fleet operations.

product.name: In-life Operations Management
product.description: A system that provides AI-driven intelligence and workflow orchestration to manage ongoing leasing operations of vehicle fleets.

product.name: Defleet to Remarketing Management
product.description: A solution to maximize vehicle value by managing the end-of-contract process and preparing vehicles for remarketing.
